This job routes tile ot_engc_t_win = window / all-gather tile (window + descriptor queues, t_ag relays, leaf resets, sink seams), variant b PD 0.60; own clock tree, pin flops on every input, flops on every output; pins aligned to the composition faces (el1011-ds-misc.log PHYSICAL SPEC ALL-TILE).
